messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: Autoscaler queue backlog detected for inference-cell-us-west-2. metric=queue_depth > 1500 for 3m. Trigger: autoscaler-warmup-window. PagerDuty incident: PD12345.

pagerduty: PD12345: page fired to @eng-oncall. escalation_level=1.

sanjay: acked. I'm on it, digging into the autoscaler logs and queue metrics.

alice: grabbing grafana + logs. which cell is this exactly?

sanjay: inference-cell-7 (us-west-2, pool-heavy). we see sustained enqueue rate spike + kvcache miss rate high. autoscaler policy attempted scale but failed handshake with provisioner (timeout 30s).

maria: customer-impact check: any 5xxs or increased tail latency surfaced? Support dashboard shows a small bump in 503s for customer A and elevated latencies for streaming endpoints. tagging customers: @acct-corpX.

bob: pasting recent errors from controller: ```Provisioner handshake failed: rpc deadline exceeded
scale-request: {cell: inference-cell-7, desired: +12}
nodepool-alloc: attempt=1 status=quota_exceeded
```

sanjay: nodepool reported quota_exceeded and then later got an auth error for IAM role. looks like two concurrent fallback flows fired: the autoscaler retried provision, and the routing fallback attempted to reroute traffic to dedicated pool, which caused conflicting allocations and extra rate limiting against cloud API.

oncall-hand: @sanjay can you try a manual provision and hold off further autoscaler retries? run `kubectl apply -f` is not enough, need cloud-side spinup: `aws ec2 run-instances --count 6 --launch-template lt-xxx --region us-west-2` (ops-only).

sanjay: starting manual spin-up now. i'm also temporarily disabling autoscaler retries for this policy: `PUT /api/v1/autoscaler/policies/inference-cell-7?retries=0`

alice: routing team, please pause automated fallback to dedicated-pool to avoid duplicate provisioning. @ops-lead?

ops-lead: pausing fallback routes for inference-cell-7 now. will post when done.

maria: notified accounts-ops about potential customer impact and ETA ~20m.

bob: note: there is a race in the control plane: when nodepool returns quota_exceeded, fallback triggers immediate reroute which spawns more API calls; we should debounce fallback for 90s to avoid API fanout. creating a ticket.

incident-bot: PD12345: acknowledgement recorded. responders: sanjay. next escalation in 20m.

sanjay: manual spin-up succeeded for 4/6 instances, the cloud API still throttled on two. increasing backoff and opening support ticket with provider.

alice: kube nodes showing `NotReady` for two nodes, image pull stalled. pulling logs: `failed to setup network: CNI timeout`. looks like provider was slow granting ENIs.

ops-lead: workaround: moving smaller jobs off this cell to free capacity. running `kubectl cordon` + `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets` on lower-priority nodes.

maria: support notified customers that mitigation in progress; flagged priority customers for SLA alerts.

bob: pushed a temporary mitigation: scaled down batch-workers in the cell to free slots for real-time inference by `kubectl scale deployment batch-workers --replicas=2 -n inference-cell-7`.

sanjay: queue depth trending down from 1600 -> 420 over 12 minutes after manual actions. still watching.

ops-lead: preparing handoff: oncall shift ends in 18m, ops-lead will take primary if sanjay needs to step off. please summarise actions and open incident doc.

alice: summary to include: root cause = concurrent fallback+autoscaler retry fanout causing quota_exhaustion + provider API throttling -> ENI/image delays -> nodes NotReady -> queue backlog. Mitigation = paused fallback routing, manual spin-up (4/6), cordon/drain low-priority nodes, scaled down batch-workers, notified customers.

incident-bot: PD12345: incident status: mitigated (queue trending down). responders: sanjay, alice, ops-lead. please confirm if we should close or monitor for 1h.

maria: monitor 1h, keep paging if queue > 800 again. ops-lead please own next 1h.

ops-lead: acknowledged, taking ownership for monitoring window. posting follow-up ticket to eng-runtime to add debounce and improve quota-aware backoff in autoscaler.

sanjay: adding runbook note: when quota_exceeded + fallback triggered, autoscaler should backoff 60-120s.

alice: copying logs to incident doc and creating postmortem draft.

pagerduty: PD12345: incident marked acknowledged by responders.

ops-lead: thanks team. handoff complete.

maria: closing communication loop with customers. will update if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
